review.description: state-interrupted now means stopped work retained for continuation; it no longer incorrectly requires manual continuation for process loss. Canonical names, aliases and foundation dependency direction remain unchanged. Added state-terminated (Stopped) for source-closed/merged work that cannot resume, with history retained; no links or procedural backlinks were added.
review.implementation: Reviewed Recover, process/closed and the persisted pending/interrupt fields: process loss and explicit user stops now have separate continuation decisions, without changing the meaning of idle or failed.
review.tests: Read startup active/inactive/interrupt fixtures and preserved stale-question assertions; tooling verifies glossary links and canonical names without adding backlinks. Closed/merged, source reopening and dirty-cleanup fixtures substantiate the separate irreversible terminal meaning.
